closure_evidence.evidence_source: real stage built by this workflow
real stage built by this workflow

accepted_checks: materials: every installed file recorded byte for byte, no missing, extra, empty or drifted file, on four independent installs

licence: every registered original present at its pinned SHA-256, no unregistered material under share/exreader/licenses, per-component notice present, checker release_ready with no failures or pending
archive ownership: 29 archives over 13 owners (SDK stages) and 44 over 26 (composed prefix), each with exactly one owning component or package
duplicate libraries: four library names ship more than one archive on every install; each copy is recorded with its own path, owner, byte count and SHA-256, and no copy is silently merged

link partition: 1 consumer link line per SDK install and 13 per composed prefix, re-parsed from the captured output and compared with the recorded classification; bundled archives and system libraries do not overlap and no system token names an installed file

SPDX 2.3: file elements equal the installed files with matching SHA-1/SHA-256, packageVerificationCode recomputed per 7.9.4, hasFiles covers every element, every owner has a package whose licenseConcluded/licenseDeclared equal the registered identifiers, filesAnalyzed=false, source reference present (pinned archive hash in sourceInfo, or download location/comment/installed licence link) and CONTAINS edges to the installed licence originals
CycloneDX 1.5: component per owner with registered licence expression and purl, file elements with matching SHA-256, dependency refs resolvable
claims: no document asserts a runtime or legal conclusion; the closure reports runtime_accepted=false, legal_conclusion=false, product_granted=false
inherited_not_regranted: Producer release blockers remain: docs/CONVERSION.md and docs/WP7-SCRIPTS.md ship build-machine absolute paths (C:/Users/) in both SDK stages. Recorded by the producer inventory as release_blockers; this closure neither fixes nor grants them.
The 3.40 installed SDK used by the authenticated producer artifacts and the 3.41.0 SDK built here are different sources; both are recorded separately and neither is presented as the other.
not_granted: Runtime behaviour of the shipped binaries
Product, Release, signing, notarization, tag and store publication
Android, iOS and Apple host packaging and their host fonts
Optional package behaviour (sync, accounts, import, interface)
Release readiness: the producer's build-machine path blockers are untouched
